package com.acme.invoicing.web;

import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.any;
import static org.mockito.BDDMockito.given;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.request.MockMvcRequestBuilders.get;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.request.MockMvcRequestBuilders.post;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.result.MockMvcResultMatchers.jsonPath;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.result.MockMvcResultMatchers.status;

import com.acme.invoicing.domain.Invoice;
import com.acme.invoicing.service.InvoiceService;
import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.autoconfigure.web.servlet.WebMvcTest;
import org.springframework.boot.test.mock.mockito.MockBean;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.MockMvc;

@WebMvcTest(InvoiceController.class)
class InvoiceControllerTest {

    private static final String NO = "INV-202610-0001230";

    @Autowired
    MockMvc mvc;

    @MockBean
    InvoiceService invoiceService;

    @Test
    @DisplayName("GET /invoices/{invoiceNo} returns the invoice as JSON")
    void getInvoice() throws Exception {
        given(invoiceService.findByNumber(NO)).willReturn(sampleInvoice());

        mvc.perform(get("/invoices/{invoiceNo}", NO))
                .andExpect(status().isOk())
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.invoiceNo").value(NO))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.outstanding").value(250.00));
    }

    @Test
    void overdue_rejectsMoreThan365Days() throws Exception {
        mvc.perform(get("/invoices/overdue").param("days", "366"))
                .andExpect(status().isBadRequest());
    }

    @Test
    void issueInvoice_returns201WithDueDate() throws Exception {
        given(invoiceService.issue(any())).willReturn(sampleInvoice());

        mvc.perform(post("/invoices")
                        .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
                        .content("""
                                {
                                  "customerId": "C-001",
                                  "amount": 250.00,
                                  "termDays": 0
                                }
                                """))
                .andExpect(status().isCreated())
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$.dueDate").value("2026-11-14"));
    }

    private static Invoice sampleInvoice() {
        return new Invoice(NO, "C-001", new BigDecimal("250.00"), LocalDate.of(2026, 11, 14));
    }
}
